props.name: values
props.description: Newest last. Push to it on whatever interval the source ticks at.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name — what is being measured.

props.name: window
props.description: Samples kept on screen. Older ones scroll off the left.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds between samples. Drives the scroll, so keep it honest.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels. The width fills the container.

props.name: domain
props.description: Fixed scale. Omit and it follows the window, easing between bounds.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS colour for the line. Defaults to the accent.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns a sample into its printed readout.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Highlight a threshold — a limit, a target, an alarm level.
